polityNote: Kingdom of Nepal, Federal Democratic Republic from 28 May 2008. NE depicts the 14 zones (NE names NPL-1134 «Bhojpur», but it is Kosi Zone: gn_name «Kosi Zone»). From 20 September 2015 the seven provinces are drawn by NPL-provinces-2015.json (geoBoundaries ADM3).

sources.title: Wikipedia — List of districts of Nepal
sources.says: 14 zones and 75 districts took effect on publication in the Nepal Gazette, 17 Dec 1962; in 1975 Bhojpur, Parbat and Dolpa changed zones and panchayats moved across 58 districts.

sources.title: Statoids — Zones of Nepal, change history
sources.says: Table of the 14 zones (1991 census populations).

spans.dateNote: The 1975 reorganisation is dated only to the year (possibly B.S. 2032 = Apr 1975–Apr 1976); the span starts on 13 Apr 1976 (B.S. 2033-01-01) to lie safely after it. Development regions (1972/1981) are unions of zones and are not drawn separately.
